details: The title is a break down on what could be done to ease the difference between harmful and none harmful mods. First take a tally from the community on what was and wasn't harmful as a mod. Like EMMVRC and REMODCE on Melon loader (Melon loader was the injector for mods to function) were not harmful nor did they have mods that ruin the fun for others, this is my example others in the VRC community may have more. Second, is try them for yourself or check youtube for what they do or have the community post/send videos of in depth information or the mod/s. Finally, list of what mods make it to the list and which ones don't (in some cases EMMVRC and REMODCE are a group of mods that still do not harm the community, but in my opinion improved the game for my experience) this may in courage the VRC community to help you the Dev. because the backlash from peoples misunderstandings and rumors of what will and is going to happen, had not just an effect on you alone. We also felt it so as someone who really enjoys your game please take these words into consideration because we want to have just as much fun as you do in the game and if you reach out people will want to help.
title: Tally, Trial, List of mods
